$comment: Temporary high/critical advisory allowlist read by the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry is ONLY justified when a fix exists but is currently un-installable under .npmrc
min-release-age=7 (the patched version is published but <7 days old). Each entry MUST be
converted to an npm `overrides` pin and DELETED from this file once its fix ages past
min-release-age (see `ageInOn`). The gate FAILS on ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here,
so the allowlist never weakens the gate for un-triaged findings. Reviewed by the Architect.

allow.runtimePath: transitive: axios@1.16.0 -> @coinbase/cdp-sdk -> @base-org/account -> @wagmi/connectors. CRLF injection requires attacker-controlled multipart field names/filenames — not a code path TeraSwap exercises (no user-driven multipart uploads through the Coinbase SDK).
allow.reason: Fix 4.0.6 is blocked by .npmrc min-release-age=7 until ~2026-06-19. TODO: replace this entry with an `overrides` pin "form-data": "4.0.6" once it ages in.

allow.runtimePath: DEV-ONLY: transitive via vitest@4.1.8 (test runner). vite is never in the production bundle (the app builds with Next.js). The advisory is a vite dev-server `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows — not reachable in CI or prod.
allow.reason: Fix 8.0.16 is blocked by .npmrc min-release-age=7 until ~2026-06-22. TODO: replace this entry with an `overrides` pin "vite": "8.0.16" once it ages in.
